summary: Iteration 22 — verified the My Work task-scoping bug fix on GET /api/tasks. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed in 3.6s. Direct measurements against the live demo tenant: (a) production@sharma.com mine=true -> total=63, mine=6, unclaimed_pool=57, other_member=0 (matches the fix). (b) production mine=false -> total=65, roles seen = {production} only (no sales/finance leakage; broader lane preserved). (c) owner mine=false spans multiple roles and returns superset of production's board. (d) owner mine=true only contains own + unclaimed owner-role tasks. (e) A targeted probe seeded a task assigned to ANOTHER production member via owner token; verified it appears in production's team-board (mine=false) but NOT in production's mine=true — bug reproduction path fully closed. Cleanup done. Frontend (production@sharma.com login → /my-work): 63 mywork-task-* cards rendered, one-to-one match with the API response; DOM audit confirmed 0 cards belonging to another user. Complete / Photo / Voice Reply buttons and Generate AI Execution Plan CTA all present on task cards; the previously seeded TEST_iter20_ask_forbidden card shows the AI Execution Guide with checklist + Ask AI buttons + Customize Steps, so existing actions still work. Messages panel populated with reminders/urgencies. Sales and Finance mine=true also verified leak-free.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1440-1454 list_tasks — the fix is correct and minimal: for mine=true, $or:[{assignee_id:user.id},{assignee_id:None,assignee_role:user.role}]; for non-owner mine=false, $or:[{assignee_id:user.id},{assignee_role:user.role}] (broader lane intentionally); owner mine=false returns all tenant tasks. Predicate is symmetric with _can_work_task and matches the coach-stats matcher (server.py:1179-1210), so all task-scoping paths are now consistent.

Note on data shape: the DB stores assignee_id as None when a task is unclaimed. The Mongo query {assignee_id: None} matches both missing-field and explicit-null documents in pymongo/motor — verified via the 57-count of unclaimed_pool matching the intended interpretation. If any legacy tasks ever set assignee_id: '' (empty string) they would slip through both branches — recommend a defensive migration or Pydantic model to normalize empty strings to None (nice-to-have, no evidence in current data).
server.py still 3032 lines — carry-forward feedback from iterations 17-21 to split into routers (tasks_router, coach_router, etc.). Not blocking.
MyWork.js line 294 uses queryKey ['tasks', true] which is distinct from the ['tasks'] key used by Tasks board — cache invalidation of one does not clobber the other. Good.
No _id serialization issues observed on /api/tasks; explicit projection {'_id': 0} preserved.

rca of the issue: Root cause: previous list_tasks handler used q['assignee_role']==user.role for mine=true which matched EVERY task in the role — including tasks explicitly assigned to another named user of that role, because assignee_role is auto-populated from the assignee's role at create/update time (server.py:1471, 1494). Fix: split the mine=true branch into an $or of two mutually-exclusive predicates — (a) tasks pinned to me by id, and (b) unclaimed role-pool tasks (assignee_id is None AND assignee_role == my role). Preservation: the non-owner mine=false branch keeps the broader OR (any of my id OR my role) so the team board still shows the whole role lane. Reproduction (pre-fix): login production@sharma.com, GET /api/tasks?mine=true, filter for assignee_id != me AND assignee_id != None → previous count would be >0; post-fix it is 0 (verified 63/6/57/0).
